name: dsh-restart-anywhere
description: Restart dsh in place from the sidebar More menu or an agent tool; running sessions are snapshotted and resumed after the restart, or a safe restart waits for them to finish and cuts nobody off. Fork of dsh-restart-anywhere 0.1.7.
author: Johannes Tebbert <info@joblessjoe.com> (https://joblessjoe.com)

dshhub.summary: Restart dsh in place; every in-progress session is told it was interrupted and resumed after the restart.
